gloss: ecology, mode of life, behavior (of organisms)

definitions.gloss: ecology, mode of life, behavior (of organisms)
definitions.explanation: The way organisms live and interact with their environment. Encompasses their habits, diet, reproduction, and relationship with their surroundings.

examples.japanese: {野鳥|やちょう}の{生態|せいたい}を{観察|かんさつ}する。
examples.english: To observe the ecology of wild birds.

examples.japanese: {深海|しんかい}{魚|ぎょ}の{生態|せいたい}はまだよくわかっていない。
examples.english: The ecology of deep-sea fish is still not well understood.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}にわたるフィールドワークで、ゴリラの{生態|せいたい}が{明|あき}らかになってきた。
examples.english: Through many years of fieldwork, the ecology of gorillas has gradually come to light.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used in scientific and documentary contexts. Often forms compounds with {系|けい} to make {生態系|せいたいけい} (ecosystem), which is one of the most frequent uses of this word. Can also be used figuratively about human groups (e.g., the "ecology" of a workplace).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {生態系|せいたいけい}: ecosystem
- {生態学|せいたいがく}: ecology (the academic discipline)
- {生態調査|せいたいちょうさ}: ecological survey

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生態|せいたい}を{観察|かんさつ}する: to observe ecology/behavior
- {生態|せいたい}を{調|しら}べる: to study ecology
- {生態|せいたい}が{明|あき}らかになる: ecology becomes clear
- {生態|せいたい}を{解明|かいめい}する: to elucidate ecology
